nodes.label: Technical Design PDF v1.1
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: Actual text extracted from all 36 PDF pages; contains proposed design and review/TBD constraints, not implemented-state evidence.

nodes.label: Proposed Deployment Topology
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: At least two stateless API replicas behind gateway/WAF, separate worker groups, highly available MySQL/Redis, private original/derived storage, managed queue and dead-letter queue.

nodes.label: Proposed Signed URL Revocation Window
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: After unbind, new URL authorization is denied immediately; previously signed media URLs expire by short TTL, recommended no more than five minutes.
nodes.rationale: Distinguish immediate application authorization revocation from the finite residual lifetime of previously signed object URLs.

nodes.label: Proposed Orphan Upload Cleanup
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: Uploaded but incomplete objects: proposed cleanup after 24h; completed unattached assets: owner-only and cleanup/reuse after 7d; outbox replays missed processing.
nodes.rationale: Recover partial uploads without exposing unused assets or retaining abandoned objects indefinitely.

nodes.label: Proposed Leased Background Jobs
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: Leases and heartbeats for processing/generation, bounded retries and dead letters; cleanup and unbind finalization remain retryable and frozen on failure.
nodes.rationale: Worker crashes and duplicate delivery must not duplicate rewards/assets or reopen a frozen relationship.

nodes.label: Pending Design Decisions TBD01 TBD15
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: Cloud vendor, media limits, joint pet confirmation timing, interaction retention, review provider, backup/delete SLA, capacity, public share revocation, export scope, app stack/auth/push/deep links and release constraints remain subject to confirmation.
nodes.rationale: TBD-10 leaves personal data export MVP versus v1.2 unresolved; distinguish these recommendations from confirmed product scope.

nodes.label: Proposed Release Gates and Recovery Guards
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf
nodes.description: Contract/migration/security scans, unit/integration/E2E and real-device checks, 1/10/50/100 percent rollout, rollback compatibility, privacy consistency and restore-time authorization/tombstone checks.
nodes.rationale: Prevent deleted data or old relationship permissions from returning after backup recovery or incompatible releases.
